motif: A band of Azul de Insígnia stencilled trim running around every building's eave or rim, topped by one flame in a glass lantern. Roofs are flat or single-pitch, with no domes of glass or glow.

buildings.why: The 45° barrel is the only upward diagonal in the race, so the leaning mass is unique at 40 px.
Horizontal creeping shed with a short stack. It contrasts with the vertical Chapel and Shrine.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Nave roof, bell tower and beam cross make a small cluster of peaks. It is a light body next to the dark Artillery and Barracks.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Chapel chain keeps its archetype and grows: double nave and two towers become a wider two-peak cluster, with off-white standards on the blue.
The siren horn sits on a timber trestle, so the span on legs reads clearly and avoids Mech's lattice.
A perch box on a tower stalk with a canvas roof. The takeoff ramp is a side tell.
Sniper Nest chain: the proof range grows the pit into a deep, rimmed backstop. Blackened sandbags give a dark body.
The steel obelisk is the race's one needle. Brass plating makes it a bright vertical.
The distilling shed with a copper still and condenser coil reads as a fat drum, in a copper body.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Church upgrade keeps the chain archetype: a low, wide L-pulpit with the censer column and flanking spires. The stone is bone-grey.
Sniper Nest chain: the stepped sandbag bench still sits in a rimmed pit, with a thin pennant mast. Canvas olive keeps the race palette.
The humblest base of its chain, a platform sunk in the mud with a sandbag rim. It is the pit that its upgrades grow.
Barracks upgrade inherits the shed mass and grows it, with two short square towers and a steel gate. Concrete grey separates it from the olive Barracks.
Tiny Watch Tower chain: the cube with the fanned barrel cradle adds an opening to the open frame. Blue panels contrast with the grey Stronghold.
A perforated lattice trapezoid with an open lattice window. It is the only lattice in the race.
A buxom urn dome with a pipe on a concrete base. The pale steam column is the tell.
Two stacked blocks with a brim on top. Bone-white concrete sets it apart from the brass Vessel next to it.
A shed with wing sheds around a central chimney and cart door. It is the only low star, and its rust brown differs from the Watch Tower.
